items.markdown:
The top-rated personal injury law firms and practices in Brisbane include established specialists recognized for plaintiff representation, such as `Travis Schultz & Partners, Splatt Lawyers, and Maurice Blackburn`.[[1]](https://splattlawyers.com.au/personal-injury-lawyers-brisbane/)[[2]](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/our-offices/qld/brisbane/)[[3]](https://www.schultzlaw.com.au/in-the-press/travis-schultz-partners-tops-doyles-guide-queensland-rankings-with-record-recognition/)

When selecting legal representation in Queensland for motor vehicle accidents, public liability, or workers' compensation, comparing firms based on their core specialties, fee structures, and location can help clarify your options.

### Brisbane Personal Injury Law Firms

| Firm Name | Location & Contact | Key Specialties | Fee Structure |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Travis Schultz & Partners** | Brisbane CBD / Statewide | Motor vehicle, public liability, complex claims | No win, no fee / structured models |
| **Splatt Lawyers** | Fortitude Valley, Brisbane | QLD Accredited Specialist advice, work & public accidents | 100% No Win, No Fee |
| **Maurice Blackburn** | North Quay, Brisbane CBD | Medical negligence, superannuation, personal injury | Conditional costs / No win, no fee |
| **Hall Payne Lawyers** | Brisbane CBD | Workers' compensation, historical abuse, public liability | Plaintiff-focused representation |

### Key Factors to Consider

- **Accreditation:** Look for solicitors recognized as Queensland Law Society (QLS) Accredited Specialists in Personal Injury Law (such as Kerry Splatt at Splatt Lawyers).[[1]](https://splattlawyers.com.au/personal-injury-lawyers-brisbane/)
- **No Win, No Fee Arrangements:** Most reputable plaintiff firms operate on a conditional cost agreement, meaning you pay legal fees only if your claim is successful. Check if there are caps on professional fees or disbursement charges.[[1]](https://splattlawyers.com.au/personal-injury-lawyers-brisbane/)
- **Independent Guides:** Top firms and individual lawyers in Brisbane are regularly evaluated and ranked in independent publications like [Doyle's Guide](https://doylesguide.com/).[[1]](https://splattlawyers.com.au/personal-injury-lawyers-brisbane/)[[2]](https://www.schultzlaw.com.au/in-the-press/travis-schultz-partners-tops-doyles-guide-queensland-rankings-with-record-recognition/)

If you tell me the **type of injury or accident** (e.g., motor vehicle, work cover, medical negligence) and whether you need a **free initial consultation** , I can narrow down which firm best fits your case.
